jobs.prompt: Fix Opus review findings in the autopilot integrate check (tools/autopilot.mjs, tools/generated-state.mjs), with tests added to tests/autopilot-integrate-clean.test.mjs (injected deps only; add temp-dir git fixtures only where a real git repo is needed). 3 HIGH runIntegrateOutputPaths takes outputs only from runManifest, which is often null: fall back to run.jobs[].outputs (and child-run outputs of lead jobs); when the run has integratable jobs but the output list is empty, BLOCK with a clear reason instead of letting integration through. 4 MEDIUM any tracked modification that is not on an output path currently does not block: block when there is any tracked modified, staged or conflicted file (untracked files and the generated state paths stay ignored), naming up to 5 files; the blocker text says to commit or move them. 5 MEDIUM collisions: compare case-insensitively when git config core.ignorecase is true, treat an output directory as colliding with any dirty file under it and a dirty directory as colliding with outputs under it (prefix matching on path segments), compare realpaths so a path through a tracked symlink collides. 6 MEDIUM state checks: use git rev-parse --git-path to check rebase-merge and rebase-apply directories plus MERGE_HEAD, CHERRY_PICK_HEAD, REVERT_HEAD, and any unmerged (U) status entry; any of them blocks. 13 LOW integrate items for a run with status failed are auto-closed only when the run has no complete job; a failed run that still has complete jobs keeps its item (or is integrated with --jobs of the complete ones by the existing path). Keep every existing test passing (tests/autopilot-*.test.mjs, tests/generated-state*.test.mjs).
